description: Rail Equipment Accident/Incident Data (Form 54) is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Railroads", published or maintained by FRA Safe Team. Rail equipment accidents/incidents, collisions, derailments, fires, explosions, acts of God, or other events involving the operation of railroad on-track equipment (standing or moving) and causing reportable damages greater than the reporting threshold for the year in which the accident/incident occurred, must be reported by railroads to the FRA on Form FRA 6180.54 - Rail Equipment ... Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Railroads". It has 157 columns, among them Adjunct Name 1, Remote Control Locomotive, First Car Number, Causing Car Initials, Reporting Railroad Holding Company, Latitude. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last data update. Attribution given: FRA Safe Team. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is U.S. federal government work, public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
